entities.summary: Philippa Mareri was a medieval Italian mystic and foundress of the Franciscan Sisters of Saint Philippa Mareri, or Poor Clares, established in 1224. Born in a small town in southern Italy, Mareri was deeply devoted to prayer and contemplation, and her sanctuary in Borgo San Pietro, near Rome, became a popular pilgrimage site. She was beatified in 1247 and her feast day is still celebrated on February 16. Mareri's legacy extends to the development of the Franciscan Order, which spread throughout Europe and beyond, and her mystical writings continue to inspire spiritual seekers to this day.
